unit_standards.title: Apply crop protection and animal health products effectively and responsibly
unit_standards.registration_status: Passed the End Date - Status was "Reregistered"
unit_standards.quality_assurer: QCTO (legacy unit standard; no SETA QA functionary listed on SAQA)
unit_standards.purpose: Mix and apply crop-protection and animal-health (agrochemical) products at the right dose, with PPE, pre/post-application procedures and emergency response.
specific_outcomes: Implement a pre-application plan.
Mix correct pest control products at correct dose rate.
Apply pest control product to crop or farm animals.
Take the necessary safety and health precautions whilst applying pest control products.
Apply post-application procedures.
Monitor and report on the process, problems and unusual occurrences to the supervisor.
Deal appropriately and effectively with emergencies.
unit_standards.regulatory_note: Application of agricultural remedies is governed by the Fertilizers, Farm Feeds, Agricultural Remedies and Stock Remedies Act 36 of 1947. Persons offering pest control to others in the course of business must register as a Pest Control Operator (s7(2); PCO Regulations GN R98 of 18 Feb 2011; registration reportedly valid 3 years - confirm against the gazette); farm workers applying remedies on their employer's farm are not PCOs. Accepted PCO courses are listed on the Registrar's application form.

unit_standards.legal_basis: OHS Act 85 of 1993, General Safety Regulation 3(4): where more than 10 employees, at least one person per group of up to 50 employees (100 for shops/offices) with a valid first aid certificate from an organisation approved by the Chief Inspector; reg 3(4) substituted by Notice 6907, GG 53783 of 5 Dec 2025.
